data.name: Fudaylah
data.gender_notes: Fudaylah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Fudaylah is derived from the Arabic word 'fadl' which means 'to return'. This name signifies a person who returns to Allah and leads a life full of taqwa and piety. The name Fudaylah carries the meaning “One who returns to Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Fudaylah usually hope their child will grow to embody one who returns to allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Fudaylah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “One who returns to Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fudaylah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: فضيلة
in_arabic.meaning: الاسم يعني التفوق والزيادة في الخير والفضل
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فضيلة مشتق من الفضل، وهو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني الرفعة والشرف، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قول الله تعالى: ﴿وَمَن يُؤْتِ فَضلاً فَهُوَ رَزِيقٌ﴾ [الروم: 39]، ويعني الاسم في اللغة العربية التفوق والزيادة في الخير والفضل، ويرتبط بالخصال الحميدة والصفات الرفيعة.

in_urdu.name: فضیلہ
in_urdu.meaning: نام کا مطلب اچھائی اور مہربانی میں اضافہ ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: فضیلہ نام عربی زبان کے الفضل سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کے معنی ہیں اچھائی اور مہربانی، اور یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی روایت میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے، جہاں یہ فضل اور کرم کی علامت کے طور پر دیکھا جاتا ہے، اور اکثر ان لوگوں کو دیا جاتا ہے جو اپنے اچھے کردار اور عظیم صفات کے لیے جانے جاتے ہیں.

in_hindi.name: फ़ुज़ैला
in_hindi.meaning: यह नाम अच्छे गुणों और महानता को दर्शाता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: फ़ुज़ैला नाम की उत्पत्ति العربية से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है अच्छे गुणों और महानता की विशेषता, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में महत्वपूर्ण है, जहां यह नाम अच्छे चरित्र और उच्च आदर्शों के प्रतीक के रूप में देखा जाता है, और अक्सर उन व्यक्तियों को दिया जाता है जो अपनी दयालुता और उदारता के लिए जाने जाते हैं.

in_pashto.name: فضیلہ
in_pashto.meaning: د نوم معنی د نیکۍ او پکښتې زیاتوالی دی
in_pashto.long_meaning: فضیلہ نوم د عربي ژبې د فضل څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د نیکۍ او پکښتې زیاتوالی دی، دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ارزښتونو سره تړاو لري، چیرې چې دا د فضیلت او شرافت د نښې په توګه لیدل کیږي، او ډیری وختونه هغو کسانو ته ورکول کیږي چې د خپلو نیکو ځانګړتیو او لوړو معیارونو لپاره پیژندل کیږي.

in_english.name: Fudaylah
in_english.meaning: The name signifies excellence and increase in goodness
in_english.long_meaning: Fudaylah is derived from the Arabic root 'F-D-L', meaning excellence and superiority, it appears in various Quranic contexts, emphasizing virtues and elevated character traits, historically used across Islamic tradition to denote individuals of noble conduct and high moral standards, symbolizing generosity and benevolence.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: فضیلہ

data.cultural_impact: The name Fudaylah is relatively uncommon, but it holds a significant place in Islamic history. The most famous bearer of this name is Shaykh Fudayl ibn Iyad, a prominent figure in the religious and intellectual history of the Islamic world. He was a scholar, Sufi ascetic, and a preacher of virtue, and he inspired countless students and followers with his Encyclopedia of Religion and Ethics, known as "Al-Jame' li-Ahkam al-Qur'an", which is a comprehensive collection of rulings on various aspects of Islamic law. Fudaylah is a reminder of the importance of returning to the fundamentals of faith and leading a virtuous life.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Fudaylah is deeply rooted in Islamic spirituality and reflects the significance of the idea of 'returning to Allah' in the Islamic tradition. It calls to mind the hadith of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), "The best of you are my generation, then those who come after them, and then those who come after them" (Sahih Muslim). Each person is on a spiritual journey to return to Allah, and Fudaylah is a constant reminder of this fundamental goal. It encourages one to lead a pious life characterized by taqwa (God-consciousness), adherence to religious practices, and continual striving for self-improvement. Fudaylah is thus a reminder of the ultimate purpose of our existence and a constant motivation to strive towards drawing closer to Allah.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Fudayl ibn Iadh is known for his deep spiritual yearning and unwavering devotion to Allah. His name symbolizes one who is constantly seeking Allah's guidance and pleasure, like a mule carrying heavy loads in the desert, yearning for the sweet waters of the Hereafter.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Fudayl ibn Iyad al-Juhani was a famous scholar of the 8th century in the Islamic world. The name Fudaylah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Fudayl ibn Iyad was a prominent scholar and Sufi saint in the early Islamic world. He was born in the Juhana tribe in the Arabian Peninsula and studied under several prominent teachers. He is known for his contributions to Islamic jurisprudence and Sufi thought.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Fudaylah remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: A successful entrepreneur named Fatima Fudaylah in Istanbul, Turkey attributes much of their success to the blessing of their name Fudaylah, which means "One who returns to Allah". They believe their name has shaped their identity and guided them through life.
